sources.note: Company homepage. Identified CareFabric platform, product portfolio (myAvatar, myEvolv, myUnity, GEHRIMED, TheraOffice), market sectors (behavioral health, post-acute, human services, public sector, payers), and AI tools (Bells AI, AlphaCoding).

ONC certifications page. Confirmed myUnity and myUnity Senior Living both hold ONC Cures Update certification. Links to EHI export documentation, real-world testing plans/results, and FHIR API portal.

Main myUnity product page. Described as single EHR for home health, hospice, senior living, skilled nursing, palliative, personal care, and adult day. Details on clinical documentation, scheduling, billing (Medicare/Medicaid/MA/commercial/private pay), ePrescribing, medication management, interoperability with Epic/Cerner/Allscripts, KPI dashboards.

Home health-specific features: point-of-care documentation, OASIS-E compliance, orders management, medication management with batch updates, CareRouter mobile dispatch, EVV via Mobile Caregiver+, Carequality/HIE integration for CCDAs, billing/claims automation.

Hospice-specific features: IDG meeting workflow automation, bereavement tracking, IPU management, HOPE scrubbing, physician orders, medication tracking, billing and reporting, mobile dispatch integration.

Senior living features: single resident record across CCRCs/AL/IL/SNF/memory care, eMAR, medication management, health monitoring with alerts, care planning, billing integration, incident reporting, role-based views.

Post-acute care overview. Listed all care settings supported. Mentioned MDS analytics (Netsmart Simple, CORE Analytics), PDPM optimization, value-based care support (GUIDE, MA, MIPS/MACRA), referral management, workforce tools.

Third-party review site. Described myUnity as cloud-based EHR for home health, hospice, pediatrics, private duty. Noted features: ePrescribing, KPI dashboards, billing/collections, telehealth (two-way HD), mobile support. User reviews praise efficiency; concerns about limited feature updates and workflow complexity. 4/5 stars (5 reviews).

LeadingAge 2024 press release. Announced myUnity NX next-generation platform with extreme usability, integrated AI, and mobility. Mentioned Apricot (generative AI for start-of-care docs), AlphaCollector (RPA for claims), AI Data Lab.
Interim HealthCare agencies implementing myUnity EHR platform — notable customer deployment.
Ohio's Hospice implementing Netsmart EHR system across their network — notable hospice deployment.

KLAS Research review page for myUnity Enterprise (LTC). Mixed reviews — solutions meet clinical/financial/admin needs but development pace is a concern. About two-thirds of customers would not buy again.

Wikipedia article (could not fetch full content due to 403). Search results indicated founding in 1992, technology origins to 1968, acquisition history, 18,000+ clients by 2011, 600 employees at that time.
GI Partners portfolio page. Confirmed current PE ownership. Noted 23,000+ customer organizations, 450,000+ care providers, 40+ state systems, serving 25M+ people.
Genstar Capital sale announcement. Confirmed ownership transition history: Genstar acquired 2010, sold to GI Partners + Allscripts 2016 for $950M.
GI Partners and TA Associates acquired Allscripts' stake in 2018. Revenue was $319M at that time.
IntuitionLabs listing for myUnity SNF capabilities. Confirmed MDS documentation, memory care documentation features.
